instructions.question: Is the user having trouble physically hitting the buttons in this window?

camera_fields.camera: Measured by the kiosk camera (above the screen, facing the user) in the last 3 s of this window, about 10 frames/s, current session only; no image. {min, med, max} = minimum, median, maximum over the frames that have the value; null = no frame had it.
camera_fields.camera.frames: number of frames in the span
camera_fields.camera.face: the face the face landmarker follows (one face), kept only when it lies in the main user's head box
camera_fields.camera.face.seen_share: share of frames (0-1) with the main user's face measured
camera_fields.camera.face.yaw_deg: head yaw, degrees (0 = facing the camera, + = turned to the image's right)
camera_fields.camera.face.dyaw_start_deg: yaw minus the yaw of the user's first face frame in this session, degrees
camera_fields.camera.face.dpitch_start_deg: pitch minus the pitch of that first face frame, degrees
camera_fields.camera.face.iod_frac_w: eye-to-eye distance / frame width (larger = closer to the camera)
camera_fields.camera.face.face_cx: face centre x, fraction of frame width (0 = left)
camera_fields.camera.face.face_cy: face centre y, fraction of frame height (0 = top)
camera_fields.camera.body: the body the pose landmarker follows (one person, not always the main user)
camera_fields.camera.body.seen_share: share of frames (0-1) with a body found
camera_fields.camera.body.pose_vis_shoulders: mean visibility (0-1) of the two shoulder points
camera_fields.camera.body.shoulder_cx: shoulder midpoint x, fraction of frame width
camera_fields.camera.body.shoulder_cy: shoulder midpoint y, fraction of frame height
camera_fields.camera.heads.head_count: head boxes found by the head detector in a frame
camera_fields.camera.heads.user_head_share: share of frames (0-1) with the main user's head box
camera_fields.camera.heads.others: one entry per other tracked head seen in the span, most seen first
camera_fields.camera.heads.others[].seen_share: share of frames with this head
camera_fields.camera.heads.others[].rel_dist: user head height / this head height (1 = same size, above 1 = smaller, i.e. farther from the camera)
camera_fields.camera.heads.others[].lateral: x offset from the user's head centre, in user head heights (+ = image right)
camera_fields.camera.heads.others[].vertical: y offset from the user's head centre, in user head heights (+ = lower)

criteria.true: Taps land outside targets near their edges, repeated taps on the same spot, the user keeps facing the screen.
criteria.false: Taps land on targets, or there are no taps because the user is reading or talking.

criteria.true: Going back, revisiting screens, long pauses with no selection while facing the screen.
